actual_scope: Can the 64-per-call centre path (eight rank-8 COPY/ERASE totals through the private temporary) be shared across calls or shrunk?
bottleneck_link: The centre path consumes 64 of about 99.6 unpaid coordinates per call, about 64 per cent of the raw deficit, so sharing or shrinking it is one of the largest single levers on the complex side. The relaxation shows the named sharing costs (restoration, hosting, precision) consume under 0.1 per cent of the k=2 ceiling, so cost does not block this sharing pattern; eligibility of a shared window and demand coupling do.
stop_rule: Stop after the k=2 smallest instance, the k=4/8/16 rows and the two break-even overhead treatments, with the eligibility, consumer and precision obligations named; no physical fused call is built, no supplier admission is attempted and the selected record is unchanged.
evidence: RESULT.json: fully charged k=2 window ceiling a<0.003215381840 (kappa<0.003205076296, 1.903x baseline) with centre charge 32, copy children 4 rank-8/call, restoration 4 scratch CLEARs/call, hosting 0 (window constraints named), precision 4 rank-1/call; gross ceiling 0.003217794406; k=4/8/16 charged ceilings 0.003981062728 / 0.004365321517 / 0.004558083777. Break-even extra rank-1 overhead per call: 1650 (identity-feasible maximum) under coverage-identity displacement, 31 for the full bit-limited gain and 32 for any gain under the additive treatment. The pinned separate (16/368/32) and fused (8/360/16) bills are reproduced exactly; six controls enforced.
